top_signals.title: Have Middle East Oil Flows Rebounded to 15 Million Bpd as U.S. Claims?
top_signals.summary: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright this week said that the oil exports from the Middle East have rebounded to 15 million barrels per day (bpd) and even topped the pre-war average of 20 million bpd on Sunday.   Vessel-tracking services and commodity analysts are baffled and struggling to reconcile these numbers with their observations of tanker loadings and traffic in the region. Ship-tracking data shows oil flows out of the Strait of Hormuz are, at best, half the volume cited by Secretary Wright. Of all oil exports out of the Middle East,…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Emerging Currencies Rise to Fresh Record on Fading Fed Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: An index tracking developing-nations’ currencies rose to a fresh record as cooling bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike boosted risk appetite, while equities extended their rally on demand for technology shares.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ankur Crawford on the Power of Mistakes
top_signals.summary: Ankur Crawford, Executive Vice President and Portfolio Manager of the Alger Capital Appreciation, Alger Focus Equity, and Alger Spectra Strategies joins Barry for a conversation about how she builds an investment strategy. They also discuss her journey from engineering to investment, along with understanding AI and compute investment cycles.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: MCX Plans India Coal, Mineral Exchanges to Boost Price Discovery
top_signals.summary: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd. plans to invest as much as 2 billion rupees ($21 million) to start coal and minerals trading platforms as the government opens up the sectors to improve price discovery and transparency in the domestic market.

top_signals.title: What will TV look like in three years? Media insiders share their predictions
top_signals.summary: CNBC asked media insiders what they think the TV market — from pay TV subscribers to sports ratings — will look like in three years.
